notes: renderer=software; unthrottled_redraw=true; frame_ms = interval between consecutive about_to_wait calls that follow a winit RedrawRequested (i.e. after Slint render + softbuffer/GL present returned, measured from the winit CustomApplicationHandler); redraw requested continuously from about_to_wait (bypasses Slint's 60Hz Timer frame throttle when unthrottled=true); first 2s warm-up not recorded. virtualised list: ring of 32 Row elements fed by a VecModel, window computed from prefix-sum heights (binary search); offset applied by a single scroll-y property
